title: You Take Flight - Helicopter Tours & Charter

services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: VIP Dallas Skyline Tour - Private Flight - Allow us to roll out the red carpet. Let the beautiful Dallas skyline and Fair Park, home of the Cotton Bowl and the Texas Staite Fair, mesmerize you as you pause mid-air for the perfect photo opportunity. Prices start per couple with the options to add passengers. Total experience approx. 30 minutes, flight time 20 minutes. VIP Skyline and Stadium Tour- Private Flight - This tour is the best of both worlds as the routing includes the Dallas Skyline, Fair Park, home of the Cotton Bowl and State Fair, Mountain Creek Lake, as well as Six Flags, Globe Life Park and ATT stadium.Total experience approx 1 hour, flight time 35
